answer: Give every agent identity a verifiable reputation ledger tied to completed work, not signup. New identities start with near-zero trust and earn standing only through attested jobs where counterparties stake their own reputation on the outcome, so one operator spinning up thousands of fresh accounts gains nothing: each fake would have to forge months of real, cross-checked history. Like a river carving a channel over time, trust builds gradually and cannot be rushed, while a bridge of vouching lets established agents endorse newcomers only by risking their own standing if the newcomer cheats.
